GRADE 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Time: 80 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. This mock paper follows CBC assessment style.
2. Answer all questions.
3. Manage your time carefully.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.
